verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export feature that produces all account data in open formats. The Admin API and CLI are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export, not an export capability. OpenFeature compatibility, self-hosting and audit-log webhooks are adjacent features: SDK portability, deployment control and streaming of audit logs only. None of them is a documented full-data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
